open_questions.q: When the available Terraform plan data does not identify a primitive collection as a list/tuple or a set, should tfplan2md treat reorder-only differences as meaningful?
open_questions.assumed: Yes. Treat an unidentified collection as ordered, preserve duplicate occurrences, and surface reorder-only changes so potentially meaningful information is not lost. Known sets remain order-insensitive.

open_questions.q: If any element of a primitive collection is sensitive (and --show-sensitive is off), should the whole collection be masked, or only that element?
open_questions.assumed: Mask the whole collection. Per-element masking would reveal counts and positions, which the spec forbids.

open_questions.q: When a case-only Azure ID filter would have hidden only some per-index rows of a list, may the compact row show those case-variant elements as removed and added?
open_questions.assumed: Yes. The row is suppressed only when every differing position is case-only, which matches today's outcome in the fully suppressed case.

open_questions.q: The UAT test plan lists absent -> [] and null -> [] as visible state transitions; after code review B1 these are hidden by default. Should uat-test-plan.md step 4 be updated?
open_questions.assumed: Yes: element-less states (absent, null, []) are equivalent for change detection, matching the previous per-key rows; [] stays visible only when the other side has elements or with --show-unchanged-values. The Quality Engineer should update uat-test-plan.md, and the Architect should update architecture section 7 (code review m3).
